subject: Aria and Bowene
decision: Aria was the cultural leader, with the influence of a great general alongside civic institutions; Bowene’s High Lord title was distinct.
interpretationLimit: The Julius Caesar comparison illustrates influence. It does not import Roman offices, a senate constitution or any particular historical actions.

subject: Yvette’s misnamed later speaker

limits: This resolves the apparent speaking-after-death discrepancy. It does not identify the other commander, establish succession or supply Yvette’s exact death scene, killer or any resurrection.

limits: This confirms the death after he is left behind in the ambush. It does not supply a recovered body, completed resurrection, killer’s identity or a universal rule about the cost of revival.
